0022600138.text: The Bucks host the Rockets at 1-3 and 12th in the East, 2.5 games behind for fifth in the Central, while Houston is 4-0, first in the Southwest, and riding a four-game win streak. There are no games yet between the two teams in the 2026-27 season, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026. Houston will be without Alperen Sengun (out, back soreness) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision.
